name: Allies (World War II)
note: Main Allied powers. Time-sliced: France at its 1939-40 strength, USSR and USA at their 1941 entry. China (ROC) to be added in Phase 2.

name: Axis (World War II)

name: Hellenic League (480 BCE)
note: The Greek alliance against Xerxes, led by Sparta and Athens. Other members (Corinth, Aegina, Megara, Plataea...) not yet modelled as separate snapshots.
